description.en: Offline search in images, scanned and mixed PDFs, and images embedded in Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Incremental indexing with highlighted previews. Once indexed, type the picture's words straight into the search box.
description.zh: 离线搜索图片、扫描与混排 PDF、Word / PPT / Excel 内嵌图片中的文字。选择目录，后台增量识别，预览高亮命中位置。建好索引后直接在搜索框输入图片里的文字即可搜到。

notes.zh: 图片文字搜索的窗口记住你拖出来的大小，下次打开、重启后都是这个大小，上次最大化的仍然最大化；双击窗口边框恢复默认大小。不想要可以在 Win顺 的 设置 › 外观 › 记住窗口大小 关掉。需要 Win顺 0.40.0。权限不变。
notes.en: The Image text search window keeps the size you leave it at, after a restart too, maximized if you left it so; a double click on its edge gives it the default size. Turn this off under WinShun's Settings › Appearance › Remember window sizes. Needs WinShun 0.40.0. Permissions unchanged.
